english.title: Drive a vehicle with insufficient fuel / power to clear the tunnel / access roads into a tunnel within Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), into a tunnel at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) within Heathrow Airport when the vehicle had insufficient fuel or other power to propel it through the tunnel and clear of the access roads to the tunnel
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 8.2(a) and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
